query: SELECT cl.id, cl.moduleId, cl.title, cl.orderIndex, cl.linkedScenarioId, cm.title as moduleName FROM course_lessons cl JOIN course_modules cm ON cl.moduleId = cm.id WHERE cl.linkedScenarioId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cl.moduleId, cl.orderIndex;
